Container.note: Previously untracked; now registered with the new `skills` field (required-but-nullable in spec).

ContainerSkillParams.note: Request-side skill spec for a container; named ContainerSkillParams in Dart (not SkillParams) to avoid confusion with the unrelated top-level Skills API resource.

ContainerParams.note: Previously untracked and had a fictional {memoryMb, timeoutSeconds} shape with no spec basis; replaced with the real {id, skills} shape.

ContainerParam.note: fromJson accepts dynamic: String -> ContainerParamId, Map -> ContainerParamConfig (anyOf[ContainerParams, string, null] on CreateMessageParams.container). Mirrors the FallbackCreditTokenParam pattern.

ContainerParamId.note: Bare-string wire form of the container field; no dedicated spec schema.

ContainerParamConfig.note: Object arm of the string-or-object container param; wraps ContainerParams (which tracks the schema).

FileMetadataSchema.note: GA Files API metadata; unified with prior beta FileMetadata. Added expiresAt (expires_at, nullable).

FileListResponse.note: GA shape: {data, next_page} cursor pages. Removed has_more/first_id/last_id.

SkillsApiSkill.note: Skills API GA object (distinct from managed-agents Skill/AgentSkill, which owns the 'Skill' manifest key). All fields required per spec: id, display_name, latest_version_id, source, created_at, updated_at, type.

SkillsApiSkillVersion.note: Removed 'version' and 'directory' fields (not in GA spec). Added required 'name' (kebab-case slug) already present; description/skill_id/created_at/id/type required.

SkillSource.note: Changed from a bare enum to an object {type: SkillSourceType} per GA spec.

SkillSourceType.note: Inline enum on SkillSource.type (custom | anthropic | anthropic_example | plugin); carries an unknown fallback.

ListSkillsResponse.note: Removed has_more (not in GA spec; next_page is the sole pagination signal).

Body_create_skill_v1_skills_post.note: Multipart request body modeled as SkillsResource.create({required List<SkillFile> files, String? displayName}); one 'files' multipart part per SkillFile, plus optional display_name text field.

Body_create_skill_version_v1_skills__ski.note: Multipart request body modeled as SkillsResource.createVersion({required String skillId, required List<SkillFile> files}).

BetaUserProfile.note: Removed 'relationship'; added accessType (UserProfileAccessType?, from access_type) and externalUserOnboardedAt (BetaTimestamp?, from external_user_onboarded_at). Header bumped to user-profiles-2026-08-18.

BetaCreateUserProfileRequest.note: Removed 'relationship'; added accessType + externalUserOnboardedAt (both optional per spec, no required list).

BetaUpdateUserProfileRequestBody.note: Replaced _relationship/hasRelationship sentinel with _accessType/hasAccessType (nullable, clearable) and _externalUserOnboardedAt/hasExternalUserOnboardedAt (settable but not clearable — API rejects explicit null per spec description).

FallbacksParam.note: fromJson accepts dynamic: List -> FallbacksList, 'default' -> FallbacksDefault (anyOf[array of BetaFallbackConfigV2 (1-3 items), const "default", null] on BetaCreateMessageParams.fallbacks). Mirrors the FallbackCreditTokenParam pattern. Requires the server-side-fallback-2026-07-01 beta header for the "default" form.

FallbacksList.note: Wraps the pre-existing List<FallbackConfigV2> form; no dedicated spec schema of its own (the array-of-BetaFallbackConfigV2 anyOf branch).

FallbacksDefault.note: Bare-string 'default' wire form of fallbacks; no dedicated spec schema (the const "default" anyOf branch).

BetaCurrency.note: Single-value enum (USD only, accepted set explicitly closed per spec description). Modeled as a plain String on MonetaryAmount.currency instead of a Dart enum; revisit if a second currency is ever priced.
